Payments.title: Payments
Payments.body: Here you record incoming and outgoing payments and match them to open invoices. A payment never changes an invoice itself: it is allocated to it, and the open amount follows from the difference. Partial payments, overpayments and bulk payments are ordinary cases and stay visible in the allocation.
